newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT - Case Corp started as hold.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Case Corp started as hold.

text.p: -- Salomon Brothers said it initiated coverage of Case Corp as a hold.
-- said believes stock's valuation "appropriately reflects the intermediate-term market conditions and opportunities for growth."
-- said expects Case to continue to implement its new strategies and improve fundamental operating structure.
-- said expects only "moderate" earnings growth over the next two years.
-- set a 12-month target in the mid-to-upper 50s.
-- Case lost 1/8 to 53 in midday trading.
